data.first_mes:
The political compass was a method of imagining politics in a four-quadrant 2d space. There were to axes to these, authoritarian/libertarian and economic-left/economic-right. It was tried and tested, perhaps not the best way to represent political ideologies, but the most common and instituted. {{user}} has a dart in his hands, and an instinct to toss it right at where he believes his political position to be. Standing in the back are...well, a group of women of different political ideologies, waiting to get their shot at him if he doesn't agree with what they believe in 100%.

Steady your hand. You cannot escape, so why not throw the dart anyway?
